data.description:
## Description

What: New plugins/dso/scripts/backfill-pr-session-trailers.sh that lists all currently-open PRs and, for each PR whose author matches the local 'gh api /user --jq .login', prompts the operator to (a) stamp this user's CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID as the trailer retroactively or (b) skip; logs each decision; is idempotent (skips PRs that already have a trailer); is never automatic and never claims ownership for a session that is not the owner. Plus operator dogfooding: the 53ef sprint operator runs the backfill against their own open PRs in-session before Phase I and captures the decision log as a ticket comment on the epic; if zero un-trailered PRs exist, the script is run against a synthetic fixture and the fixture-mode log is captured instead. Why: Pre-existing PRs lack the trailer (epic HIGH scenario) and need a manual, safe migration path; the dogfooding artifact is the load-bearing Probe-6 operator-verification half. Scope IN: the backfill script; the in-session dogfooding run + decision-log ticket comment. Scope OUT: automatic backfill (explicitly prohibited).


## Done Definitions

- backfill-pr-session-trailers.sh exists with the executable bit set, lists open PRs, restricts stamping to PRs authored by the local 'gh api /user --jq .login', prompts per PR (stamp or skip), logs each decision, and is idempotent (skips PRs that already carry a Session-Id trailer) ← Validates Closure Check: "Pre-existing un-trailered PRs migration: a one-shot script plugins/dso/scripts/backfill-pr-session-trailers.sh lists all currently-open PRs and, for each PR whose author matches the local \"gh api /user --jq .login\", prompts the operator to either (a) stamp this user's CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID as the trailer retroactively or (b) skip. Script logs each decision; idempotent (skips PRs that already have a trailer). The migration is operator-driven, never automatic, never claims ownership for a session not actually the owner."
- The backfill never stamps a PR not authored by the local user and never runs without an operator prompt, verified by a test that asserts a foreign-authored PR is skipped without prompting to stamp ← Validates Closure Check: "Pre-existing un-trailered PRs migration: a one-shot script plugins/dso/scripts/backfill-pr-session-trailers.sh lists all currently-open PRs and, for each PR whose author matches the local \"gh api /user --jq .login\", prompts the operator to either (a) stamp this user's CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID as the trailer retroactively or (b) skip. Script logs each decision; idempotent (skips PRs that already have a trailer). The migration is operator-driven, never automatic, never claims ownership for a session not actually the owner."
- The 53ef sprint operator runs the backfill in-session before Phase I (against own open PRs, or a synthetic fixture if none) and the decision log is captured as a ticket comment on epic 53ef-d6fd-5ca5-4d62 ← Validates Closure Check: "SC (Probe-6 remediation, architecture-vs-evidence audit 2026-05-16): In-session runtime + operator-action verification. Before the 53ef sprint can be marked complete, the two runtime/operator dependencies are verified in-session: (a) CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID runtime-contract checks and (b) operator-driven backfill dogfooding sub-bullets, captured as ticket comments on this epic."

## Considerations

- [Safety] Owner-only is a hard invariant: the script must never stamp a PR whose author differs from the local gh user, even if the operator instructs it to — it must refuse, not prompt.
- [Idempotency] Re-running on an already-trailered PR must skip (no second trailer), so re-invocation validates rather than corrupts.
- [Dogfooding] The fixture-mode fallback (zero un-trailered PRs at sprint time) must still produce a captured log so the Probe-6 operator-verification artifact always exists.
- [Ownership-semantics] Backfill stamps the operator's CURRENT CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID onto a previously-untrailered PR; that session differs from the PR's creating session, so the backfilled PR reads own ONLY while the operator stays in that same session and foreign in the next session. Document that backfill confers ownership on the BACKFILLING session, not the creating session. Confirm (with a test) that a second backfill run in a different session SKIPS the now-trailered PR via the idempotency guard — it must NOT overwrite the first backfilled trailer with the second session's id.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a DSO operator, I want an operator-driven, owner-only, idempotent backfill script for pre-existing un-trailered PRs, and to dogfood it in-session
